messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: INC-1934567 — router.latency.p50 > 200ms in us-east-1 for 3m. Auto-escalation window started. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-1934567 :rotating_light:

sara_eng: acked INC-1934567 :white_check_mark: I'm on it.

mike_oncall: seeing a brief spike in p50, any customer-facing errors? @jordan_support can you check support queue?

jordan_support: no new tickets referencing model timeouts. Saw a flurry of 503-ish traces in logs ~2026-03-15T14:51Z but nothing persisted.

alex_sre: looking at grafana — router CPU climbed to 85% on a couple of hosts, autoscaler added pods but warmup caused kv cache misses. p50 back to baseline now. suspect transient pre-warm/thundering herd.

alex_sre: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:51:21Z router[pid=223] WARN request=abc123 lat=312ms cache=miss
2026-03-15T14:51:26Z router[pid=224] WARN request=def456 lat=287ms cache=miss
```

sara_eng: throttled alert duplicates — looks like PD window fired multiple times as metric oscillated. Can we suppress duplicate pages if condition clears within 2m? :thinking_face: 

mike_oncall: agreed, filed a follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1729 to tune suppression and add prewarm heuristics. For now, marking INC-1934567 no-customer-impact, PD auto-resolved. Handing off monitoring to alex for a short postmortem.

alex_sre: will collect spans and check KV warmup timeline. ping me if it recurs.

jordan_support: thanks — monitoring support queue, will reopen if any customer shows up. :pray:
